verdict: Leads dipped this week; cost per lead is up and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 109 leads at an average cost of $7.24 per lead, but the most recent 7 days saw a 34% drop in leads while spend held nearly flat — pointing to creative or audience fatigue in the retargeting campaign rather than a budget issue. Your Google Business Profile activity also went quiet over the past week, which removed an organic source that had previously been contributing steady top-of-funnel interest. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to relieve retargeting pressure, and GBP activity is being investigated and restarted. You should expect lead volume to stabilize and begin recovering over the next reporting period as those changes take effect.
